events.title: John Cassavetes Retrospective – 35mm Screening
events.location: Cinema A, GOMA — Gallery of Modern Art
events.description: A curated screening of John Cassavetes' influential independent cinema presented in original 35mm format, followed by informal conversation among film enthusiasts.

events.title: Archie Moore: kith and kin (Exhibition)
events.description: An immersive and deeply researched installation exploring Aboriginal genealogy and history, providing a profound space for contemplation on identity and culture.

events.title: The God of Small Things: Faith and Popular Culture (Exhibition)
events.description: An exhibition exploring the intersection of spiritual belief systems and contemporary media, inviting viewers to reflect on cultural narratives and sociological influences.
